name: google-mcp
description: Google Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a

platform_mcp_google_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_google_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of the app that the Google Ads user authorised with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords.

platform_mcp_google_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_google_client_secret.description: The OAuth client's secret; sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

platform_mcp_google_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_google_refresh_token.description: Refresh token obtained once through Google's consent flow (offline access, scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

platform_mcp_google_developer_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
platform_mcp_google_developer_token.description: Google Ads API developer token (manager account > Admin > API Center), sent as the `developer-token` header on every call; Test-access tokens only work against test accounts.

platform_mcp_google_customer_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_CUSTOMER_ID
platform_mcp_google_customer_id.description: Google Ads customer id (10 digits, no dashes) of the account being managed: pause_resume mutates campaigns under it, and list_accounts reads its customer_client hierarchy (itself plus direct clients when it is a manager). When the user reaches it through a manager account, also set login_customer_id.

platform_mcp_google_login_customer_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
platform_mcp_google_login_customer_id.description: Manager customer id (digits, no dashes) sent as `login-customer-id` when the user reaches client accounts through a manager account; leave unset for direct access.

platform_mcp_google_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_ENV
platform_mcp_google_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_google_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_google_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v25/customers:listAccessibleCustomers lists the customers directly accessible with the OAuth token as `resourceNames` (customers/{id}).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: googleAds:search on the configured customer_id with the documented account-hierarchy GAQL query (customer_client, level <= 1): the account itself plus its direct clients. Search returns fixed pages of 10,000 rows with a nextPageToken; `page` is not sent.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /v25/customers/{account_id}/googleAds:search with a fixed GAQL query (non-removed campaigns). account_id is the 10-digit customer id without dashes. `status` is not applied (GAQL is a literal; the runtime cannot splice arguments into it); the budget is campaign_budget.amountMicros in raw (micros of the account currency, not mapped to `budget`). One call returns up to 10,000 rows; `page` is not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: googleAds:search on customers/{account_id} with GAQL `FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '<date_from>' AND '<date_to>'` (dates YYYY-MM-DD, as in the documented custom-range example): one row per campaign per day. cost_micros is the cost in micros of the account currency (divide by 1,000,000); int64 metrics arrive as strings. `campaign_id` is not applied (filter the rows). Up to 10,000 rows (one page).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /v25/customers/{customer_id (config)}/campaigns:mutate {operations: [{update: {resourceName: customers/{customer_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}, status: PAUSED|ENABLED}, updateMask: status}]} ("All updates require an `updateMask` field"). The campaign must belong to the configured customer_id; answers {results: [{resourceName}]}.
